title: 火锅店的鬼

series.next: A new note under the club's door: the next ghost is real.

setting: 老蒋火锅, Chengdu, 2 am, after closing. The Fake Ghost Club's first case, and yours.

jiang.name: 蒋叔
jiang.en: the owner, in his apron, shaking

pan.name: 小潘
pan.en: the night cook, in a hurry

steps.narr: A laugh, from the cold room. Then a ringtone.

steps.en: I'm not scared! I'm... a bit scared.

say.en: Ask 蒋叔 when it started.
say.tip: 什么时候 shénme shíhou = when. ……开始的？ = (when) did it start?

ok.en: Last week. Two o'clock, every night.

answers: 这种情况是什么时候开始的？
这事儿是从什么时候开始的？
3.tip: 这种情况 = this kind of thing. 这事儿 = this business (northern, chatty).

steps.narr: His phone rings as he goes. The same ringtone.

say.en: Ask her where she is at two o'clock.
say.tip: 两点 liǎng diǎn = two o'clock (两, not 二, before 点). 在哪儿？ = where (are you)?

answers: 每天两点的时候，你在哪儿？
每天晚上两点，你一般在哪儿？
3.gloss: Every night at two, where are you?

steps.narr: 包子 creeps to the cold-room door, and hisses.

say.en: Set the trap: call 小潘's phone!
say.tip: 打电话 = make a call; 打小潘的电话 = call 小潘's phone.

answers: 别出声，打小潘的手机试试！
3.gloss: Shh. Try calling 小潘's phone!
3.tip: ……试试 = try ...ing: 打一下试试 = give it a try.

not.note: Her orders prove where she was at two. Whose phone rang in the cold room?
He's the one who called you in. Whose phone rang in the cold room?

say.tip: 就是 jiùshì = is none other than: 鬼就是小潘！

miss.narr: Everyone looks where you're pointing: at 包子.

miss.en: 包子's offended. It's 小潘, surely?

answers: 鬼就是小潘，他根本没回家！
3.gloss: It's 小潘! He never went home!
3.tip: 根本 gēnběn = at all: 根本没回家 = never went home at all.

steps.en: 小潘? He's in the cold room?

say.en: Coax 小潘 out gently, or tell 蒋叔 straight.
answers: 小潘，出来吧，我们不说出去。
say.gloss: Come out. We won't tell anyone.
say.tip: 说出去 shuō chuqu = let it out, tell people. 不说出去 = we'll keep it to ourselves.

ok.zh: 我拿辣椒，给我奶奶做酱。
ok.en: I've been taking chillies, to make my grandma's sauce.

alts.gloss: Boss, the ghost's in the cold room!

then.zh: 我拿辣椒，给我奶奶做酱。
then.en: I've been taking chillies, to make my grandma's sauce.

fail.en: 小潘? He's in the cold room?

alts.gloss: The ghost's in the cold room!

answers: 出来吧，我们保证不说出去。
小潘，出来吧，我们保证不说出去。
3.gloss: Come out. We promise we won't tell.

answers: 蒋叔，您的鬼就在冷库里！
蒋叔，您要找的鬼就在冷库里！
alts.gloss: Boss, your ghost is right there in the cold room!

steps.en: Your sauce? Let me taste it.
That's good! We'll sell it here!

steps.narr: Back at the club: a note under the door.

steps.en: 小潘's sauce is on the menu by Friday, and nobody says how you found it. 🌶️

else.en: 蒋叔 tells every customer you caught his ghost. The sauce sells out anyway. 🌶️
